name: Git Repos
description: Monitor local git repos and push changes from iPhone

tools.name: refresh
tools.description: Re-scan local repositories and update status for all tracked repos.

tools.name: commit
tools.description: Commit staged changes in a repository. Generates an AI commit message via Ollama or accepts a manual one.

tools.name: push
tools.description: Push committed changes to the remote tracking branch.

tools.name: pull
tools.description: Pull latest changes from the remote tracking branch.

tools.name: discard
tools.description: Discard all uncommitted changes in a repository after confirmation.
